summary: Results-driven marketing manager with 8+ years of experience leading digital campaigns, brand strategy, and content marketing. Proven track record of increasing ROI by 40% and growing audience engagement across multiple channels.

Managed social media accounts with 100K+ followers. Created and optimized paid ad campaigns with $50K monthly budget. Collaborated with sales to align marketing efforts with revenue goals, contributing to 25% YoY growth.
